title: Hearty Saudi Arabian Shallot Onigiri
description: A vegan-friendly, kid-friendly Saudi Arabian dish featuring shallots and shaped like nigiri, with a mustardy and fluffy texture.
instructions: Rinse the Japanese rice thoroughly and cook it according to the package instructions.
In a pan, heat the sesame oil over medium heat and saute the chopped shallots until they are softened.
In a large bowl, mix together the cooked rice, sauteed shallots, vegan mayonnaise, whole wheat flour, apple cider vinegar, Dijon mustard, and salt.
Using wet hands, shape the rice mixture into small triangular or oval shapes, similar to nigiri.
Serve the onigiri immediately, or store them in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to a day.
To serve, garnish with additional chopped shallots and a drizzle of sesame oil if desired.
These onigiri can be enjoyed at room temperature or slightly warmed in the microwave.
Experiment with different seasonings and fillings to create unique variations of this dish.
